ValidationRule.description: Mandate Role and Contact Or User Field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR (ISBLANK(Text(Role__c) ), AND( ISBLANK( Contact__c ), ISBLANK( User__c )), AND( NOT(ISBLANK( Contact__c )), NOT(ISBLANK( User__c ))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must add Role and populate either a Contact or a User but not both
